articles.title: Crypto campaign fund Fairshake faces $2 million setback in Florida primaries
articles.snippet: In a race that drew criticism to crypto's leading political action committee for featuring fake headlines in ads, Fairshake's expensive effort fell short.

articles.title: AI could supercharge crypto but there’s a catch, Fidelity Digital Assets says
articles.snippet: AI agents could boost crypto activity, but much of the value may bypass blockchains and their tokens.

articles.title: MiCA cracks down on USDT in Europe... but no one else cares
articles.snippet: USDT is disappearing from regulated European platforms, but there is little sign that it has resulted in weakening global demand for Tether.

articles.title: Bitdeer signs $400M AI cloud computing deal for Malaysia facility
articles.snippet: Bitdeer expects revenue from the five-year agreement to begin in early 2027 as it builds toward 350 megawatts of AI cloud capacity by 2028.

articles.title: FalconX, Ethena bring USDe backing assets into $1B institutional credit facility
articles.snippet: The $1 billion facility will deploy assets backing USDe into overcollateralized institutional loans, expanding Ethena’s sources of returns beyond crypto basis strategies.
